head: Agoda's app adds an AI assistant that plans and books trips
dek: Agoda's AI Assistant is now in its app in 21 markets, including the US, India, Australia, Japan, Singapore and the UAE, after a limited test that started in September. You can plan, compare and book in one chat.
details: It checks live prices and availability across Agoda's more than 6 million places to stay, plus flights, tours and attractions. The chat runs on OpenAI models; restaurant and sight details come from Google Maps through Gemini. Bookings, saved ideas and unfinished plans collect on a trip planner page.
where: Agoda app on iPhone and Android, 21 markets
means: If you book with Agoda, you can describe a trip in plain words and get options you can book right away, instead of searching hotels and flights one by one.
todo: Update the Agoda app and tap the AI Assistant tab in the bar at the bottom. Check dates and prices before you pay.
